# Musical Chairs

> > The leading global marketplace and directory for classical music professionals, connecting orchestras, opera companies, conservatoires, and musicians through job listings, courses, competitions, and instrument sales.

Musical Chairs serves the classical music industry with a comprehensive platform for publishing opportunities and discovering international musical organizations. The site aggregates job postings, educational courses, competitions, and instrument sales while maintaining a searchable directory of orchestras and opera houses worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Job Listings
- Orchestras
- Opera Houses
- Conservatoires
- Competitions
- Courses
- Instrument Sales
- Music Ensembles
- International Directory
- Classifieds
- Subscription Plans
- Publishing Rates
- Global Database
- Search Filters

## Publishing & Classifieds

- [Publish Jobs, Courses, Competitions, Instruments Sales & more](https://www.musicalchairs.info/publish): Publish jobs, courses, competitions, instruments sales on Musical Chairs

## Organization Directory

- [International Directory of Orchestras & Opera Houses](https://www.musicalchairs.info/orchestras): Search international directory of orchestras and opera houses
